artworks.title: The Songs of War
artworks.description: This drawing depicts various scenes related to the war. The composition is divided into multiple sections illustrating different aspects of wartime life. Soldiers are shown in marching formation with musical notes nearby, suggesting a military band or the spirited atmosphere of a march. Another section features figures engaged in military drills or a speech, showcasing camaraderie among troops. A central figure on horseback dominates part of the image, labeled "Maidson's chief". Other areas highlight different emotions, such as a soldier gazing at a portrait of a woman labeled "The girl I left behind me". In the corner, a solitary musician is depicted, seated with an instrument. The drawing style is detailed and narrative, suggesting it captures the spirit and sentiments of wartime through visual storytelling.

artworks.title: News from the War
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a collage depicting scenes of military life and communication during wartime. The illustration contains numerous vignettes showing soldiers, military life, receiving and delivering news, and a scene of someone deeply affected while reading a letter. In the upper left, there are figures dressed as sailors, standing by a large cannon. Across the top is an image of a woman seated and leaning on a table in apparent distress. The bottom left shows soldiers in formation. A central portion highlights a soldier on horseback with a bugle, wrapped by the words "War News Illustrated." The lower right portrays people actively engaged in reading and discussing newspapers. The detailed composition reflects on the multiple aspects of communication and the emotional impact during a time of war, focusing primarily on how news is received and processed by different groups.

This is a drawing of a historical allegory focusing on themes of war and peace. The illustration encapsulates various scenes, likely depicting moments and figures significant to the period of the American Civil War and Reconstruction era. Central to the image is a large wheel labeled as the "WHEEL OF THE UNION" with years marked from 1860 to 1869. Around the wheel are scenes of battle, figures representing political or military leaders, naval imagery, and peaceful pastoral life. A prominent figure stands at the top of the wheel holding a scroll labeled "EMANCIPATION." Other elements include a group of soldiers, a naval battle, and a cannon in combat readiness. Below the wheel, peaceful scenes illustrate farming and domestic life, featuring figures working in fields and engaging in homely activities. This drawing encapsulates the transition and contrast between times of war and peace, with historical and allegorical significance reflecting the era's pivotal developments.

artworks.title: Fantasy on a Magnificent Triumphal Artch
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink, heightened with reed pen and brown ink, some brown wash (laid on eighteenth-century card)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an elaborate architectural structure featuring grand arches, columns, and detailed stonework. The design includes large arches, columns, circular medallions, arched windows, and a colonnade leading into the depth of the structure. In the distance, an obelisk-like structure is visible. The drawing uses cross-hatching and bold lines to define depth and form.

artworks.title: The Madonna and Child with Saint John the Baptist
artworks.medium: black chalk with traces of white chalk, outlines pricked for transfer; laid down
artworks.creditLine: Purchased with funds from The Armand Hammer Foundation
artworks.description: Drawn with gray chalk lines and smudges against dark tan paper, a woman sits facing to our left on a low wall, with two toddler-aged babies at her feet, filling this vertical drawing. Their bodies are outlined with smoke-gray lines and filled in with paler gray areas, giving the drawing an almost ghostly look against the dark paper. Both children have short hair and rounded, pudgy bodies.  The woman has a subtly rounded figure, a straight nose, and smooth cheeks; her bow lips are closed. Her wavy hair is loosely pulled back and tied at the nape of her neck. Her dress, with a scooped neckline, is cinched at the waist before flaring into a voluminous skirt. She smiles down at the nude baby who stands to our left, looking up at her and leaning against her knees with his weight mostly on his right foot. Her left hand holds his left arm, which reaches across her lap toward a book she presses against her side with her left forearm. His right hand touches her left knee, nearest us, and her right hand passes behind him to caress his shoulders. The second child kneels in a crouch near the woman’s legs, to our right. Leaning on a slender staff like a walking stick, he wears a garland of leaves in his hair and looks up toward the other boy. Chalk strokes and white highlights around his torso suggest he is wrapped in drapery. Some details are difficult to make out because some of the charcoal-gray lines are loosely sketched and retraced. The corners and edges of the paper are chipped, revealing an underlying surface to which it is attached,  and there are crease lines that suggest that the paper was likely folded in the past.

artworks.title: A Party in a Roman Villa [recto]
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an architectural scene with various figures and elements. The scene depicts a complex layout with architectural structures, including columns, archways, and detailed facades. There are figures throughout the scene, some engaged in conversation, while others are reclined or in motion. Additionally, there is a horse and rider captured in motion towards the left. The drawing is sketch-like, with delicate lines emphasizing movement and structure over detail. The composition suggests a lively scene against a backdrop of classical architecture and landscape elements.

artworks.title: Studies for the Rape of the Sabine Women [verso]
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of figures in dynamic poses. The description includes several human forms, primarily male, sketched in various muscular and dynamic postures. The drawing style suggests a study of human anatomy and motion, with figures depicted both standing and seated, some interacting with each other, capturing a sense of action and energy. The contours and musculature are emphasized by the detailed and fluidity of the line work. The drawing is done in a monochrome palette, focusing on form and movement rather than color.

artworks.title: Guardian Angel
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 24.8 x 19.2 cm (9 3/4 x 7 9/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image depicts three figures. In the center is a winged figure, likely an angel, sitting on a cloud. The angel has curly hair and is wearing ornate robes. Sitting on the angel's lap is a smaller, nude child with curly hair. Below them is an adult male figure who appears muscular. The background shows swirling clouds. At the bottom of the image, there is text.

artworks.title: Sheep at the Watering Place (Abreuvoir aux moutons)
artworks.description: The image is an etching of a pastoral scene with a flock of sheep close to the viewer. The horizon is in the distance with detailed trees and leaves. The etching shows fine linework and delicate strokes for texture. The sepia-toned color palette gives a warm feel. The sheep are near water with a shepherd observing. The composition is balanced by leafy trees framing the scene and leading to the sky.

artworks.title: The Enrollment of the Troops
artworks.description: The image features three figures in a detailed sketch, each depicted from full body. The center person stands with their arm extended forward. This individual has mid-length, wavy hair and wears a textured outfit with knee-high trousers, a belted waist, a feathered accessory, and a sword. To the right, another person faces sideways and seems to be in motion. This figure wears a detailed costume with a feathered hat and intricate patterns on their attire. To the left, there is a partial depiction of a third person wearing elaborate clothing, including a coat with decorative buttons and a feathered hat. The background is plain.

artworks.title: A Boy on a Sled
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with brown, blue, and pink wash on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Neil Phillips
artworks.description: The image shows a person sitting in a small boat. The individual is in a seated position, leaning back slightly, with legs extended in front of them. Their facial features are softly outlined, with round cheeks and closed lips. The person wears a distinct, floppy hat and is dressed in a buttoned, long-sleeved tunic with a ruff collar, puffed sleeve cuffs, breeches, and stocking-like leggings. They hold a long pole in both hands, appearing to use it to propel the boat. The background is minimal and neutral, with soft lines indicating gentle waves or water, but no other distinct features or objects are present.

artworks.title: Village atop a River Cliff [recto]
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink and wash over traces of black chalk on blue laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a landscape with a group of low buildings sitting on top of a mountain overlooking a body of water. The buildings stand among rocky formations and low trees or shrubbery. The horizon is high, and there are more faint mountains extending into the distance. Closer to us, a person appears to sit or stand on a low shore across from the mountains. The scene is created with lines of brown ink lines on blue paper.

artworks.title: Buildings on a River Bank [verso]
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink and wash over traces of black chalk on blue laid paper
artworks.description: This drawing shows a landscape with buildings on a flat terrain, including what appears to be a tower on the right. The horizon on the left features distant mountains, and closer to us some horizontal lines suggest a body of water with low trees at the edge. The scene is sketched with brown lines on blue-toned paper.

artworks.title: Bacchanal
artworks.medium: pen and black ink over graphite on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of three figures in dynamic poses. The figures are draped in flowing garments and one holds a tambourine. The background includes a stone wall and foliage. The floor has grapes and broken pottery scattered around.

artworks.title: The Ploughman
artworks.medium: etching in black on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a pastoral scene with a farmer and his plow team. The horizon is low in the image with a sky filled with clouds. Trees are seen on the horizon, and there are chickens in the foreground near straw stumps. The farmer, wearing period clothing, is guiding the plow drawn by two horses. The artwork features detailed brushwork capturing textures of the field and horses. The color palette is monochrome, focusing on shading for visual depth and realism.

artworks.title: J.B. Cardon
artworks.description: The image is a portrait of a person shown in profile, facing to the right. The view captures the upper body from the shoulders upward. The person has styled hair swept back and tied with a ribbon, portraying 18th-century fashion. Their facial features include a high forehead, aquiline nose, and a firm chin, with a clean-shaven face. The person wears formal attire with a high collar and cravat. There is no visible jewelry or objects being held. The background consists of a circular frame with multiple concentric borders. The name "J.B. CARDON" and a date "1782" are displayed at the bottom.

artworks.title: P.J. Marco
artworks.description: The image is a detailed pencil drawing of a man's head and neck in profile view. The man is facing left with finely drawn facial features, curly hair, and a slightly closed mouth. He is dressed in a high-collared garment with intricate details, and the drawing features a circular frame with concentric circles in the background. Text below the portrait likely includes the person's name and the artist's details.

artworks.title: A Man with a Turban and Striped Shirt
artworks.medium: mezzotint with some engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a portrait of a person from the waist up. The individual is in a half-profile with the head turned slightly to the person's left. The facial features are sharply captured, with a pronounced nose and lips gently parted. The person's hair is mostly covered by a large turban or headwrap with subtle folds. They are dressed in a garment with a textured fur collar over a striped fabric. A prominent bracelet is visible on one wrist, with a hand raised elegantly near the chest. The background is a plain, dark surface.

artworks.title: The Drunken Silenus
artworks.medium: etching and engraving printed in brown on heavy wove paper [restrike printed by the Regia Calcografia, Rome]
artworks.creditLine: Transferred from The Library of Congress
artworks.description: This is a drawing of mythical creatures surrounding a wine barrel. The etching shows satyrs and a bacchante near a large wooden vat of wine. One satyr looks mischievous, while another man reclines with a cup and grape leaf crown. The scene exudes indulgence and merriment typical of Bacchic celebrations. The background features a rustic atmosphere, with a curious donkey and another wine container. Shadow and texture are used skillfully to depict the energetic yet relaxed scene.

artworks.title: Le Nozze degli Dei: Frontispiece
artworks.creditLine: Transferred from The Library of Congress
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornate stage set design. The illustration depicts an elaborate stage backdrop, featuring a large curtain in the upper portion with text detailing the title "Le Nozze degli Dei" and additional information about its musical representation in Florence. Below the curtain, the stage is depicted with decorative elements, including circular designs on the middle wall resembling maps or celestial figures and flanked by detailed columns, alongside inset alcoves containing statues. The stage's ceiling appears ornate with patterned drapery. The style and precision suggest it is an architectural or set design plan.

artworks.title: Prima Scena Representanta Firenza
artworks.creditLine: Transferred from The Library of Congress
artworks.description: The image shows a group of figures gathered in an outdoor setting, with a central horizon featuring a cityscape in the distance. The figures are positioned among trees, with fine, intricate lines suggesting textures and depth. Heavenly figures are visible among clouds in the upper part of the image. The color palette is monochromatic, focusing on black and white variations.

artworks.title: Seconda Scena Selva di Diana
artworks.creditLine: Transferred from The Library of Congress
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a ceremonial gathering. Figures are engaging in dance-like formations in a clearing. The sky is detailed with clouds, some in the shape of seated figures. The brushstrokes capture the trees and clouds with fine lines, creating texture. The color palette is monochrome, mainly shades of grey. Figures are seen observing or participating in the ceremony, with trees framing the scene on the sides.
